correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the affine model with vertices (-p,0),(1,0),(0,-q),(0,1), its piecewise-linear Minkowski gauge, coverage outside the coordinate rectangle for lambda>=1, and the interior minimum of two translated-gauge envelopes. The four quadrant maximizations yield the northeast maximum 1+(1-pq)/(1+q) for p<=q, attained at (1-p,(1-pq)/(1+q)), inside 2Q. Exposed-edge gaps exclude lambda<1. The formula has all-positive quantifiers, includes p=q=1 and limiting p,q->0 but excludes degenerate shape p=0. An independent exact-Fraction piecewise-affine vertex/equality-line solver reproduced all 36 p,q pairs from {1,1/2,1/3,1/5,2/3,3/4}; finite corroboration is not the all-parameter proof.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate, but where the statement is infinite only the reconstructed analytic argument justifies the universal quantifier.
